articles.title: Matthew Lillard Calls His Superman 2 Character 'A Very James Gunn Moment'
articles.summary: Superman 2: Man of Tomorrow brings Daredevil: Born Again actor Matthew Lillard into the wider James Gunn DCU, but comic fans might not recognize his character. Man of Tomorrow mixes a returning cast with fresh characters as David Corenswelt’s Superman agrees to an unsteady alliance with Nicholas…
body: Brainiac is the antagonist this time, giving us a bigger-brained baddie than Superman’s bald-headed human rival. A guy with a bigger brain is basically Luthor’s own kryptonite.

Rachel Brosnahan will return as Lois Lane and Skyler Gisondo is back as Jimmy Olsen. These returning cast members will bump into players from the wider DCU, including Blue Beetle and the Justice Gang. Matthew Lillard’s role in all this, however, has not been announced.

On a promotional tour for Prime Video’s adaptation of Carrie, Lillard was asked whether his character is someone comic fans will recognise or not. Fan theories that he would play the DCU’s Barry Allen were previously shot down by DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn.
"It's a very James Gunn moment,” Lillard told The Direct. “So, I wouldn't worry too much about finding him in the comics."

articles.title: Blue N.O.V.A. Introduces its Own (Literal) Halo to the PvE Shooter Genre | IGN Preview
articles.summary: Built around a potentially brilliant mechanic that feels tailor-made for a PvE shooter, Blue N.O.V.A. has a ton of potential. But I left my hands-on demo and interview session with a few questions.
body: Set in a far-flung future where a rogue AI threatens what remains of humanity, thus propelling the people to new worlds, you're tasked with fighting the program and hopefully taking back a planet on the way. Not the most original setup, but at least it's topical!

That premise is meant to set up an iconic cast, which the developers seem really excited about. Beyond the high-profile Japanese voice actors they promise to recruit, the Tokyo-based publisher has also invested heavily in creating V-Tubers from the cast of Blue N.O.V.A. and even runs their social media channels in character. It's a lot for a game that doesn't seem close to coming out (it’s currently listed for 2027 without a precise date or window). From the inside looking out, it's hard to gauge these things against the chunk of game I played, because aside from a few 3D models, there wasn't much there. These public personas were not represented in the slice I played.
points: Built around a potentially brilliant mechanic that feels tailor-made for a PvE shooter, Blue N.O.V.A. has a ton of potential.

articles.title: Check Out 46 Seconds Of New Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Gameplay (And A Pink Chocobo)
articles.summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation aims to be the biggest chapter in the remake trilogy, not only in the number of regions players can explore, but also in verticality. Square Enix had previously shown off how the game's cast will be able to skydive into new locations on the world map, but for a taste of…
body: While that's a lot of empty space to fly through, it's still impressive just how much of it there is. Of course, this is only one part of the game, and there's no guarantee every region will have caverns this massive. But considering how Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth greatly expanded on the environments of Final Fantasy 7 Remake with its open-world design, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is expected to raise the bar by increasing the size of the world around Cloud and the rest of the gang. Revelation will also introduce Cid's iconic airship, the Highwind, which will serve as the gang's base of operations, and unfortunately, Chadley is there too.
All that "planetary-scale" content will take up a lot of space on your PC or console, with game director Naoki Hamaguchi estimating the game will be "around" 200GB.

One of the big games to look forward to next year, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation will launch on April 8, 2027. It's estimated that a complete playthrough could take as long as 100 hours--something Hamaguchi had done 46 times already when last we spoke to him--and two post-launch expansions starring Vincent Valentine and Sephiroth will follow in the game's wake.

articles.title: Steam Next Fest Was Flooded With Slop. These 50 Demos Cut Through The Noise
articles.summary: The October Edition of Steam Next Fest was, unsurprisingly, a complete mess. What was once a fun week-long festival of early game demos has become a dumping ground for vibe-coded AI slop, making it increasingly hard to find and wishlist good games.
body: While Next Fest is over, many of those games' demos are still readily available to download and play. The Top 50 Next Fest demos for October 2026 span a wide variety of genres and themes, and the list shows a few trends. Social, co-op, and friendslop games rose to the top, as people couldn't get enough of multiplayer chaos in party games like Worst Class Ever, while Fart Together offered physics-driven goofiness and intestinal turbulence.

Niche management and shopkeeper sims also attracted players, with Questing Goose Studio's Probably Stolen and Victorian-gothic gem-cutting sim Abyssal Lapidary proving popular. Anyone looking for low-effort experiences will likely enjoy desktop companion games like Character House, and anticipated sequels like ArcheAge Chronicles drew big player numbers. One thing to note is that some of these games--like Teach My Little Sister How To Drive --do have AI disclosures attached, which you can filter for.

articles.title: Xbox Workers Are Eligible For Buyouts As Part Of Huge Shakeup At Microsoft
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced a new program called the Voluntary Exit Offer that it's extending to thousands of workers at the company, including people on the Xbox team. Microsoft is doing this to shed employees, but the messaging is that a program like this could be appealing to someone who was already…
body: Microsoft shared the high-level details of the Voluntary Exit Offer on its blog, and Bloomberg had more insight. The report said 60,000 workers are eligible for the Voluntary Exit Offer, and this works out to more than 25% of Microsoft's entire workforce.

Bloomberg reported that Xbox is one of the divisions of Microsoft whose employees can leave the company via the Voluntary Exit Offer, along with Windows, Copilot, and finance teams. The report said people working on Microsoft's efforts in data centers, sales, marketing, cyber security, and quantum computing are not eligible.

Microsoft made this announcement just two days before it releases its next earnings report on October 28. The technology giant is spending hundreds of billions of dollars in its massive AI push, and many in the investment community have questioned if that level of capital expenditure makes sense.

articles.title: "This is a serious incident" - Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse suffers cyberattack
articles.summary: Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios has confirmed it's suffered a "serious" cyberattack, saying it is currently working to determine the "full extent" of its impact.
body: "To our players and friends," a statement by the studio read. "We're sorry to share that Warhorse Studios has been hit by a cyberattack. We're working with cybersecurity specialists to secure our systems and understand the full extent of what happened. Thank you for standing with us." The message was released at 11am GMT and there hasn't been an update from the studio since. We've separately asked the studio if there have been any developments.

Warhorse CEO Martin Frývaldský discussed the incident in a Czech report (translated by DeepL), saying, "This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and for everyone affected. Our immediate priority is to secure our systems, determine the full extent of the breach, and take all necessary steps to protect our employees, partners, and our community. We are devoting all necessary resources and capabilities to resolving this situation."

articles.title: Nintendo Announces Indie World Showcase For October 28
articles.summary: Nintendo has announced a new Indie World Showcase for October 28 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET. The broadcast will run about 15 minutes and, like previous streams, will focus on a wide range of games from third-party Nintendo partners.
body: "Tune in for roughly 15 minutes of new announcements and updates on indie games coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch," Nintendo's announcement read.

Nintendo's last Indie World Showcase was held back in March 2026, and it showed off several upcoming games at the time. Many of these have already been released, including the high-energy Denshattack, a port of the underrated twin-stick shooter Minishoot' Adventures, and the shadow drop of one of 2025's best games, Blue Prince.

Short and sweet, the Indie World Showcase offers a broader look at the smaller games coming to Switch consoles. The end of the year is fast approaching, and Nintendo's 2026 holiday-season blockbuster will be a remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It was heavily featured in September's The Legend of Zelda 40th anniversary Nintendo Direct, alongside other Zelda-centric announcements.

articles.title: 'Kingdom Come: Deliverance' Studio Hit by Major Cyberattack
articles.summary: Kingdom Come: Deliverance developer Warhorse Studios appears to be the latest game studio hit by a cyberattack. The studio confirmed in a statement that it was affected by a cybersecurity incident and is currently assessing the extent of the damage.
body: “This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and everyone affected,” said Martin Frývaldský, CEO of Warhorse Studios. “Our immediate priority is to secure our systems, establish the full extent of the breach, and take the necessary steps to protect our employees, partners, and community. We are dedicating the resources needed to address this situation and will communicate further information as soon as we responsibly can.”
Warhorse said it won’t be conducting interviews or providing additional comments about the situation, and that it will share further verified information when it becomes available.

Video game studios have faced a wave of cyberattacks in recent years, with Grand Theft Auto 6 developer Rockstar Games arguably taking the brunt of it. In September, Rockstar was hacked by the group ShinyHunters. Before that, Cyberleeks hit the company and released stolen GTA 6 gameplay footage and, years prior, Rockstar suffered a major breach which revealed an early development build.

articles.title: Revisiting Ecstatica - the pioneering survival horror that used its fancy ellipsoid graphics tech to fill its world with dongs
articles.summary: There's a well-known phenomena in video games development known as time-to-penis. It's a somewhat tongue-in-cheek measurement of the time players, when given an exciting suite of new customisation tools, will take to create the first inevitable in-game dong.
body: Ecstatica, developed by Andrew Spencer Studios and published by the long-defunct Psygnosis, originally released back in 1994. It follows a bumbling traveller who unwittingly becomes embroiled in the fate of a demon-cursed medieval village after making a rest stop in search of water. It was heavily inspired by survival horror game granddaddy Alone in the Dark (and arrived a full year before Resident Evil), but while it adopted a similar fixed-camera approach to its adventure, it had some tricks all of its own.

Most immediately notable was the decision to build its pre-rendered backdrops and characters out of ellipsoids; giving the medieval village of Tirih and its surrounding environs a softer, more organic feel compared to the angular lines afforded by the limited polygons of the time. And even today its bold, vibrant, and decidedly spherical aesthetic is quite unlike anything else.
points: There's a well-known phenomena in video games development known as time-to-penis.
It's a somewhat tongue-in-cheek measurement of the time players, when given an exciting suite of new customisation tools, will take to create the first inevitable in-game dong.

articles.title: Pokémon Center Opens More Baffling 30th Anniversary TCG Orders
articles.summary: Pokémon 's Eevee-themed 30th Anniversary Battle Deck is scheduled to drop on Oct. 30. A week after that is the release date for the highly-awaited Pokémon 30th Anniversary Ultra Premium Collection, the most expansive (and expensive) product in the celebratory lineup.
body: Instead of offering pre-orders for items that would make sense, TPC decided to start selling 30th Anniversary Poster Collection boxes today. Don't get me wrong: the product and its three legendary bird promo cards are a great pickup, and especially attractive at the manufacturer's suggested retail price of $14.99. Despite months of availability, some poor Pokémon fans still haven't managed to purchase a single 30th Anniversary box — and a TPC drop is a new opportunity to correct that.

It's still wild that we are this close to the release of the UPC without any official pre-orders. Normally, TPC does pre-orders for new products at least a month before launch. As reported before, the UPC and its exclusive Future Rare card, Classic Collection pack, and 30 boosters is already a hot commodity that is being resold well above MSRP. Even against an endless horde of bots, TPC is probably the single most realistic option for Pokémon fans who want the UPC without sacrificing most of a paycheck.

articles.title: Star Wars Battlefront 3 Could Break New Ground, but Only if EA Takes the Risk
articles.summary: After years of speculation and fan campaigns — and a major surge in interest in all things Star Wars Battlefront after Andor season 2's success — Star Wars fans finally got some fantastic news: Star Wars Battlefront 3 exists.
body: Although the news came shortly after the sad announcement that legendary RPG studio BioWare would be shut down, EA president and chief studio officer Cam Weber also revealed that Respawn and DICE would collaborate to bring Star Wars Battlefront 3 to life.

It’s been nearly a decade since DICE released Star Wars Battlefront 2. While its launch was far from rosy because of pay-to-win mechanics that DICE and EA quickly revamped after widespread backlash, the multiplayer game eventually became a well-loved addition to the Star Wars video game universe. Speaking strictly for myself, I’m pumped to see where Respawn and DICE take Battlefront 3.
That said, we do have opinions. Specifically, where we hope EA and the Battlefront 3 developers take the action-shooter next: The High Republic.

Playing fan-favorite characters in familiar settings is central to the Battlefront series. But EA also needs to avoid retreading old ground, and we believe the best way to do that is to explore the High Republic era.

articles.title: Roblox users have made a playable version of Counter-Strike and full, working PlayStation games that you can play right now
articles.summary: Multiple remakes of beloved games including Counter Strike, The Simpsons: Hit and Run, and Super Hot, are available to play on Roblox right now. These have not been uploaded by the original game's creators.
body: One game - which is listed as an 'experience' in Roblox parlance, has been released by Roblox user Takeoff Interactive and listed as 'just a passion project', is a game "inspired by Counter-Strike" and has no monetisation according to its description. Eurogamer played this game today, and it looks and plays exactly like Counter-Strike.

The game includes the standard bomb diffusion mode, where two teams fight over two bomb sites. There are missing sound effects, the smoke doesn't look as good, and a friendly bot stabbed me in the back while diffusing a bomb, but otherwise it looks to be a largely identical recreation of Valve's game, albeit without Valve's involvement.

As for the PlayStation Experience, it's a full working PlayStation 4 dashboard with a media gallery, web browser, and trophies. There's even a server-based chat feature, in which Roblox players can talk to each other. The dashboard includes seven playable games - most of which are indie games. These include: The Simpsons Hit and Run, Cluster Truck, Superhot, Gang Beasts, Five Nights at Freddy's, Undertale, and PaRappaTheRapper.

videos.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Review (Campaign and Multiplayer)
videos.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign and multiplayer review by Simon Cardy.
body: An all-action campaign full of twists and turns, MW4's single-player shines, but the multiplayer portion of Modern Warfare 4 is quite a bit duller. Solid foundations and a novel new arena ensure there’s plenty of fun to be had, but the majority of its new modes and maps do little to excite due to some unimaginative design choices and awkward spawn positions. The combination of these two halves is a much-needed reminder of what Call of Duty can be at its best, even if it can’t fully recapture the heights of its glory days.
